title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis 2027/2028, 24-month proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and your letter of 12 September.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.17 (po:4500013023-10) through EUR 5.24 (po:4500013392-10), EUR 5.43 (po:4500013795-10) to EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10) between 2025-10-06 and 2026-09-24. That rise is already in our price.

We would like to give you planning security instead of a one-year term. The attached term sheets cover 94,800 kg per year over 24 months, with a fixed price and no adjustment clause. This gives your capacity and purchasing a firm base load for two years.

Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant of the peeled bar is available?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis 2027/2028, 24-month proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We welcome your proposal for a 24-month agreement to ensure planning security, but we must include an AS-14404 index clause as we cannot fix prices over such a long period. Taking your historical price data into account, we can offer €5.36 per unit for this 24-month indexed package with 30-day payment terms.

Our main current Angebot is a price of €5.28 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.36 per unit. This alternative package provides a price of €5.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Regarding your technical inquiry, our specialists will reach out to discuss whether a more cost-effective variant of the peeled bar is suitable for your application. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Please note that our offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – 24-month fixed-price package
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for taking the price history into account.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Your letter of 6 July states that your nickel and alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027. For that reason we would keep the package clause-free. The attached term sheet covers 94,800 kg per year over 24 months, with 60 days payment. This gives you a firm base load and removes the administrative workload of monthly surcharge adjustments.

Could you also tell us the earliest lead time you can confirm for the first call-off in January 2027?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – 24-month fixed-price package
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

While our alloy requirement is covered until March 2027, a 24-month agreement extends well beyond this period, making the AS-14404 index clause necessary. Building on your requested 60-day payment terms and 24-month duration, we can offer €5.21 per unit with the required index clause. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.21 per unit. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.09 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – revised term sheet, 24 months clause-free
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and the delivery schedule.

On volume: our attached term sheet commits 94,800 kg per year over 24 months. That is our full requirement for this bar, called off evenly as in your schedule. We cannot bind a higher quantity.

We have moved our price a real step toward you. We would like to keep the package clause-free and on 60 days payment. Your letter of 6 July confirms your alloy cover runs to March 2027. A fixed price also removes the monthly surcharge calculation and invoice corrections on both sides.

Could you confirm the earliest lead time for the first January 2027 call-off, given your holiday shutdown?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – revised term sheet, 24 months clause-free
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you very much for your continued interest in our extensive range of high-quality stainless steel products and our reliable delivery service. 

We are pleased to present our offer for a contract term of 24 months, featuring a price of €5.04 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. As the 24-month term extends well beyond our current alloy cover ending in March 2027, the AS-14404 index clause remains a strict requirement for this package. 

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, we can offer a price of €5.16 per unit under a contract term of 24 months and a Zahlungsziel 60 days net. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Please note that our offer remains valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our logistics department will contact you directly regarding the earliest lead time for your January 2027 call-off.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
